resources.string: See the animation and feel the vibration
Tap a level to see its cue. Each level starts in the colour of the one before, as on a real discharge.
Animations are off (\"Design animations\"): the video does not move, only the colour frame shows.
This device cannot vary the vibration strength: the swell at 5 % plays as pulses.
Battery saver is on: Android does not vibrate. The picture shows the cue a little stronger instead.
Silent mode: no vibration. The picture shows the cue a little stronger instead.
Notification vibration is off in the system settings: no vibration. The picture shows the cue a little stronger instead.
